dia_chi_raw: 9th floor, Viet A Tower, 9 Duy Tan.
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Lead the DevSecOps function, managing a team of DevSecOps and Site Reliability Engineers.
Architect and implement CI/CD pipelines optimized for secure, compliant delivery.
Own Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards across Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
Manage cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) with BFSI-grade reliability and controls.
Containerize applications and manage orchestration via Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE).
Define and enforce access control, secrets management, and environment isolation.
Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (e.g., PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, RBI Guidelines).
Lead efforts in observability, monitoring, and incident response (Grafana, ELK, Prometheus).
Collaborate with InfoSec and risk teams to integrate DevSecOps in the SDLC.
Perform capacity planning and cost optimization for cloud infrastructure.
Drive adoption of GitOps and policy-as-code tools (e.g., ArgoCD, OPA, HashiCorp Sentinel).
Build runbooks and disaster recovery strategies for critical BFSI workloads.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
3+ years in DevSecOps/Infrastructure roles
Strong knowledge of CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes.
Cloud certifications in AWS, Azure, or GCP preferred.
BFSI or regulated-industry experience is highly preferred.
Experience with secrets management tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
Familiarity with secure SDLC, static/dynamic analysis, SAST/DAST tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to interact with technical and business stakeholders.
Nice to have
Knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
Experience in implementing observability as code.
Working knowledge of zero-trust network models.
Experience with Kafka, Redis, or other high-performance back-end tech.
Strong documentation and reporting background.
